paragraphs: Big technology companies are investing heavily in humanoid robotics, and racing to bring AI from screen interfaces into physical homes and workplaces.

Meta recently developed a prototype humanoid named Max in just three months. They want to provide a physical body for its digital AI assistant. Proponents argue that building robots with human-like form allows them to navigate spaces, handle tools, and use infrastructure designed specifically for people. However, tech critics argue that current AI remains unreliable for real-world physical tasks. Human environments present unpredictable challenges and make delicate interactions such as handling fragile household objects extremely difficult to execute safely. Furthermore, developing autonomous home assistants requires gathering vast amounts of spatial data. This raises major cybersecurity concerns regarding surveillance, data privacy, and potential hacking risks.

While researchers work on advanced 3D spatial mapping to help machines navigate rooms, experts remain divided over whether consumer humanoid robots are an inevitable step forward or an overhyped financial gamble.

paragraphs: Big tech companies are building humanoid robots to bring AI into our daily lives. Meta recently created a prototype robot called Max, and they hope it can work in homes and offices.

Supporters say robots shaped like humans can move around rooms and use everyday tools easily. But tech critics argue that these robots are not ready for normal homes. Rooms have many small obstacles, and robots can easily break objects or fall over. To work well, these machines also need to record video of private rooms, which creates serious security and privacy risks. Researchers are using 3D maps to teach robots how to move safely, but experts still disagree on whether home robots will become part of real life anytime soon.

paragraphs: Tech companies want to put robots with AI into our homes. Meta makes a new robot called Max. It walks on two legs.

Some people think robots which look like humans can help us clean, pick up things, and work. But other people say that robots make too many mistakes. They can break glass, fall, or get lost in small rooms. Also, home robots use cameras to see everything. This can make people feel unsafe in their own homes.
Scientists are teaching robots how to walk safely with the help of 3D maps. But it will take a long time before robots can safely live with us.
